picks.title: Musely secures $360M from General Catalyst without giving up equity
picks.why_it_matters: A $360M non-dilutive deal signals GC is experimenting with alternative capital structures that could reshape how growth-stage DTC companies finance customer acquisition—worth watching if this model trickles down to earlier stages.

picks.title: Coatue has a plan to buy up land for data centers, possibly for Anthropic
picks.why_it_matters: Major VCs vertically integrating into AI infrastructure reveals the compute bottleneck is so severe that investors are securing physical assets—creating openings for startups solving power, cooling, or efficiency at the edge.

picks.title: Eka's robotic claw feels like we're approaching a ChatGPT moment
picks.why_it_matters: Emerging signal that robotics manipulation may be hitting an inflection point similar to LLMs in 2022—early-stage VCs should be scouting founding teams building on this wave before valuations spike.
